journeys.description: Project選択 -> Projectタブ -> Docsセクション確認
journeys.testName: UJ-001: Docs section display after project selection
journeys.reason: Existing E2E test covers this journey with 6 test cases: Project tab existence, clicking shows file list, Docs section displayed, header shows 'Docs', files from docs/ displayed, directory nodes displayed

journeys.description: Docsセクション -> フォルダクリック
journeys.expectedResult: フォルダが展開/折りたたみ
journeys.reason: Existing E2E test covers this journey with 5 test cases: collapsed icon initially, clicking expands, expanded shows children, clicking collapses, collapsed hides children

journeys.description: Docsセクション -> .mdファイル選択
journeys.testName: UJ-003: Markdown file selection and display
journeys.reason: Existing E2E test covers this journey with 3 test cases: clicking selects file, displays in ProjectFileEditor, correct .md icon displayed

journeys.description: Docsセクション -> .pdfファイル選択
journeys.testName: UJ-004: PDF file selection and display
journeys.reason: Existing E2E test covers this journey with 4 test cases: clicking selects file, displays PdfViewer component, contains iframe element, correct .pdf icon displayed

journeys.expectedResult: 以前の選択・展開状態が復元
journeys.testName: UJ-005: State restoration after tab switching
journeys.reason: Existing E2E test covers this journey with 4 test cases: expand and select then switch tabs, returning restores expansion state, returning restores file selection, editor shows selected file content
